# Transfigure

> Free, private file converter that runs entirely in the browser via Rust
> compiled to WebAssembly. No uploads, no accounts, no tracking, no server —
> files never leave the user's device. Free forever, open source (AGPL-3.0).

Transfigure is a single-page web app (https://transfigure.ing). There is no
API and no backend: all conversion happens client-side in WebAssembly, so
there is nothing to call or crawl beyond the page itself.

## Key facts

- Every conversion runs locally in the browser; no network request carries
  file data anywhere.
- No account, sign-up, usage limits, or telemetry.
- Works offline after the first page load (WASM binary is cached).
- Source available under AGPL-3.0-only: https://github.com/RephlexZero/transfigure

## Supported conversions

- Images: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, AVIF, QOI, TGA, HDR, DDS, EXR, ICO, SVG → PNG
- Audio: MP3, FLAC, OGG, WAV → WAV
- Documents: Markdown ↔ HTML, MD/HTML/TXT → PDF, PDF → TXT/HTML, DOCX → TXT/HTML, RTF → TXT
- Data: CSV ↔ JSON, CSV ↔ TSV
- Config: JSON ↔ YAML, JSON ↔ TOML
- Encoding: Base64 ↔ Binary
- Batch output: ZIP, TAR.GZ, TAR.XZ, 7Z

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://transfigure.ing): the converter itself
- [README](https://github.com/RephlexZero/transfigure/blob/main/README.md): tech stack, build/dev instructions, architecture
